description.value: The Field Community Centre serves as the social hub of Field, BC, a small mountain village nestled inside Yoho National Park along the Trans-Canada Highway. Situated at roughly 1,240 metres elevation amid dramatic Rocky Mountain scenery, it is one of the few community facilities available to travellers in this remote corridor. Touring cyclists on the Trans-Canada route may find it a welcome waypoint between Golden and Lake Louise.

Field, BC is a real, tiny community adjacent to Yoho National Park on the Trans-Canada Highway, and the OSM record shows no closure indicators, supporting inclusion.
